body.name: crush-config
body.description: Use when the user needs help configuring Crush — writing crushrc (the Bash config format) or crush.json, setting up providers, models, LSPs, MCP servers, hooks, skills, permissions, or changing Crush behavior.
body.label: system:crush-config

body.name: crush-hooks
body.description: Use when the user wants to add, write, debug, or configure a Crush hook — gating or blocking tool calls, approving or rewriting tool input before execution, injecting context into tool results, or troubleshooting hook behavior in crush.json.
body.label: system:crush-hooks

body.name: jq
body.description: Use when the user needs to query, filter, reshape, extract, create, or construct JSON data — including API responses, config files, log output, or any structured data — or when helping the user write or debug JSON transformations.
body.label: system:jq
